subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the open conflicting fork PR for this Feishu reply-mention bug, or close it and land a fresh narrow target-repo fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the exact current candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, stale, and previously reviewed as needing safer mention-gating and session-routing behavior.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the existing branch as context, but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author to rebase and address the prior proof, gating, and routing concerns.

options.title: Defer Feishu reply work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu bug without starting another repair lane until Feishu channel ownership is available.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing branch as context, but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and scope-aware routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the most recent merged work in the Feishu mention gate and can route the safe mention-detection shape.
